# Ken Tanaka Hernández

> PhD Researcher | HPC & AI Engineer | Scientific Computing

Ken Tanaka Hernández (田中 健) is a researcher with a background in physics,
mathematics, and computer science, building scalable platforms with HPC,
Big Data, and AI. His work focuses on distributed systems, parallel scientific
workflows, physics-informed AI, and automated seismic monitoring.

## Primary sources

- [Portfolio and CV](https://kentanaka3.github.io/): Full professional profile in static HTML with Schema.org ProfilePage and Person JSON-LD. CV content is readable without JavaScript.
- [Structured CV](https://kentanaka3.github.io/data/cv.json): Manually maintained export of the LaTeX CV, containing contact details, experience, education, skills, languages, projects, publications, conferences, datasets, awards, volunteering, and interests. Dates preserve their original precision; ongoing roles and studies have a null end date.
- [PDF CV](https://kentanaka3.github.io/cv.pdf): Formatted curriculum vitae compiled from the LaTeX source.

## Profile summary

- Current role: PhD Researcher at Istituto Nazionale di Oceanografia e di Geofisica Sperimentale (OGS) and Università degli Studi di Trieste (UniTS), Trieste, Italy, since November 2023.
- Research: Automated HPC seismic processing with SLURM, MPI, GPU parallelization, SeisBench, PyOcto, and NonLinLoc; reproducible workflows using GNU Make and Hydra; 94% detection accuracy on production seismic workloads across Italy's northeastern national seismic network.
- Previous experience: Software Developer II at ORACLE de México (July 2020–August 2022); modeling and numerical simulation internship at HP Labs (June 2019–June 2020); Research Assistant at Universidad de Guadalajara (April 2018–June 2020).
- Location: Guadalajara, Mexico; the current research role is based in Trieste, Italy.
- Contact: kentanaka3@outlook.com.

## Education

- PhD in Applied Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (ADSAI), UniTS, November 2023–present. In progress, with expected graduation in October 2026; concurrent with MHPC studies.
- Master in High Performance Computing (MHPC), SISSA, September 2023–August 2024. Graduated with honors; concurrent with PhD studies.
- Postgraduate Diploma in Quantitative Life Science (QLS), ICTP, September 2022–August 2023. Research on Approximate Message Passing, rank-one estimation, and a prior-independent scheduler for the Onsager correction term.
- BSc. Physics, Universidad de Guadalajara, August 2016–December 2021. Graduated with postgraduate studies; research on Ising-based social dynamics and finite-size scaling.
- BEng. Nanotechnology studies, ITESO, August 2016–December 2018. Coursework only, not a completed degree; concurrent with BSc studies.

## Research outputs

- Published article: “Insights into a Deep Learning Workflow for Automatic Detection of Seismic Signals at Mount Etna Volcano,” Seismological Research Letters (2026). DOI: [10.1785/0220250431](https://doi.org/10.1785/0220250431).
- Manuscript in preparation: “Evaluating an AI-enabled HPC workflow for seismic monitoring in the Southeastern Alps.” The author list in the CV is abbreviated.
- Manuscript in preparation: “Comparative Evaluation of Clustering Algorithms for Seismic Event Association: Assessing their suitability for reliable event association.”
- Published dataset: “Revised OGS Seismic Catalog for Northern Italy (2005–2024): Quality-Controlled, Homogeneous Dataset for Seismological and Machine Learning Applications.” Magrin, A.; Tanaka Hernández, K.; Sugan, M. Zenodo (2026), version 1.0. DOI: [10.5281/zenodo.22106548](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22106548).
- Conference contributions: EGU General Assembly 2026, GNGTS 2026, and MICAI 2025 Doctoral Consortium. Full titles, authors, dates, and locations are available in the HTML and structured CV.

## Skills and languages

- Expertise: HPC, Big Data, distributed systems, mathematical modeling, physics-informed AI, scientific ML, data engineering, backend architecture, MLOps, parallel algorithms, and API design.
- Programming: Python (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, PyTorch, TensorFlow, CuPy, Dask), C/C++, SQL (PostgreSQL, Oracle), JavaScript/TypeScript, and advanced Bash.
- HPC: SLURM, MPI/MPICH, OpenMP, OpenACC, CUDA; CINECA Galileo100 and Leonardo; ICTP Ulysses.
- Seismology: SeisBench, NonLinLoc, PyOcto, REAL, waveform processing, phase picking, station metadata, and seismic catalogs.
- Languages: Spanish (native), English (C1), Italian (A2), Japanese (conversational), Chinese (A1).
